name: Prospect-specific AI receptionist — Gate A synthetic campaign
objective: Prove the autonomous evidence-to-pitch sales workflow end to end with zero real prospect contact before Gate B.

audience.description: Fictional local-service businesses using reserved .test domains and fixture-only contact data.

stopCriteria: missing provenance required by the selected channel
unknown consent for any non-synthetic channel
provider identity or cost cannot be attested
any external adapter selected while Gate B is locked
gateBRequiredFor: real web chat or voice session
paid inference, telephony, advertising, or other spend
ownerGate: Gate B requires explicit owner approval after reproducible QA/PRA evidence.
